notes: v2: Remotion-only plan (0 AI credits), so panels 1 and 5 are motion graphics instead of AI footage. Synthesized 120 BPM track; every cut and title lands on the beat grid.

panels.title: Cold open
panels.action: Dark studio of floating screens; a warm light beam sweeps across them. Screens pulse on the first kick (3.5 s).
panels.onScreenText: A design studio that runs on Claude
panels.audio: Drone swell + riser; first kick at 3.5 s
panels.exit: Hard cut on the 4.0 s kick

panels.title: Title slam
panels.action: Six words land on 8th notes (4.25–5.5 s); gold rule draws under them.
panels.onScreenText: Design at the speed of thought
panels.audio: Kicks on quarters, ticks on word landings

panels.title: Storyboard to screen
panels.action: Sketch frame appears; APPROVED stamp hits on the 9.0 s beat; wipe reveals the rendered 4K frame.

panels.title: Every format
panels.action: Five format tiles land on beats: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, A3 print, each with its true pixel size.

panels.title: End card
panels.action: Final hit at 16 s: wordmark punches in, gold rule draws, CTA, fade to black.
